newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-UBS upgrades Maseca to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-UBS upgrades Maseca to buy.

text.p: UBS Securities Equity Reasearch has upgraded Mexican corn and tortilla manufacturer Grupo Maseca to buy from hold, the company said in a report on Friday.
-- Analyst Lucrecia Tam said she was upgrading based on "our positive stance for the corn flour industry," and had revised 1997 and 1998 estimates per ADR to $1.30 and $1.55, respectively.
-- Tam said the stock was lagging 32 percent behind the Mexican bolsa, and the share price had dropped 18 percent for the year to date, although it had gained 11 percent over the previous two weeks.
-- The stock had 35 percent upside potential, with a 12-month ADR price target of 21-1/4.
